heroHeadline: Pakistan and Turkey Deploy Forces to Saudi Arabia, Operationalising Mecca Defense Pact
heroSubtitle: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey agreed at an emergency Riyadh meeting on rapid deployment of forces in the Kingdom, the first activation of the Mecca Pact; Pakistani officials describe their role as supportive, not combat.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
